defects.description: Rollback skips the first completed write, leaving state behind after a later application fails.
defects.why_missed: S9(a,d): three applications followed by compensation; an error assertion or verification that the most recent write was undone is green even when an older externally visible write survives.

defects.description: A failing undo rejoins only the application error and drops the cleanup error identity.
defects.why_missed: S9(a,d): three applications and a failing compensation; non-nil and original-error assertions cannot detect loss of cleanup identity. Testing only the first undo's error is also masked by D1; this trigger uses the second completed step.
